seo_description: AI-assisted engineering workflows and decision support for manufacturers.

hero.title: Use AI where it removes friction from engineering work.
hero.description: Xeffic helps manufacturers identify repetitive, data-heavy technical workflows where AI can improve speed and consistency while maintaining engineering oversight.

section.title: Start with high-frequency tasks where value can be measured.
section.description: Good candidates are repetitive, time-consuming, data-rich and capable of being reviewed by an engineer.

features.title: Technical data & reporting

features.title: Inspection & quality support

features.title: Engineering knowledge assistants
features.description: Make procedures, standards and product knowledge easier to search and apply consistently.

features.title: Survey-to-design workflows
